The '''Polis Massa Asteroid Field''',<ref name="Strongholds" /> often simply known as '''Polis Massa''', was a collection of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] formed from the remnants of the [[Polis Massa cataclysm/Legends|destroyed]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]].<ref name="TNEGtAS" /> The [[Kallidahin/Legends|Polis Massans]] maintained several facilities in the asteroid field.<ref name="TCSWE" />
